sourceProjection.basis: Visually reviewed page 33 figure 29 as a top-down measured-current-state auditorium plan with undistorted room and box outlines, plan-view stairs, and no perspective convergence. Page 27 figure 23 is retained only as identity evidence for current Apollinee room names, not extracted geometry.

Visually reviewed appendices 2 and 3: complete top-down plans of the foyer and Sale Apollinee levels with parallel wall runs, plan-view door swings and stair treads, and no perspective convergence. Appendix 2 includes a printed scale. Both scans are slightly rotated on the page but retain equal x/y scale.

review: The complete appendix 2 foyer plan, complete appendix 3 Sale Apollinee plan and figure 29 first-tier auditorium plan were inspected at native embedded-image resolution. Appendix 3 preserves the entire Apollinee level, including all five halls, the central stair, north-wing stair/service core and perimeter context. The 2023 measured-current-state figure 23 independently names the same five halls and records the current renamings used by the model. Pages 25-26 distinguish historical west stair blocks from current north-wing access; no cross-floor link is asserted without a shared labelled shaft. Page 33 identifies figure 29 as the pepiano or first box tier, while page 35 states that its central axial bay is an entrance and locates the imperial loggia on the two tiers above; the Royal Box guide stop is therefore left unbound without an upper-tier plan.
limitations: 三组独立平面分别记录完整门厅层、观众厅局部与完整阿波罗厅层；各图保持原图比例，但没有跨图测量配准。
2018 年论文称参观由大楼梯上行，2023 年实测研究则称西侧旧楼梯已停用、现由北翼楼梯上层；因此不绘制推测的跨层连接。
图 29 只记录第一层包厢；论文说明该层中轴为入口、皇家包厢位于上方楼层，因此皇家包厢路线节点暂不绑定到此平面。
舞台以渐变阴影表示，缺少可无损分离的完整源图面；保留舞台定位点，但不以渐变中心残片冒充完整可选区域。
开放时可见的运河水门不在三张审查平面范围内。

rasterLayers.reason: Complete appendix 2 plan split by reviewed source-coordinate regions. Visible double-line wall runs, stair enclosures and load-bearing columns remain exact source-pixel wall geometry. Only door leaves and swing arcs, stair-tread interiors, entrance furniture and the non-structural inner outline are demoted in tight reviewed flat-detail regions. Printed room text, dimensions, section markers, street labels and scale are masked; no generic wall rectangles are generated.

rasterLayers.reason: Reviewed neutral-grey source fills identify the auditorium perimeter, proscenium masses and box partition or pier bodies. A 3-pixel opening removes only one-pixel antialias fringes and the retained wall mask remains a subset of original grey pixels; the source-coordinate exclusion removes the shaded stage surface without touching the adjacent structural masses, while the two reviewed stair-platform rectangles remain flat detail.
Reviewed black source linework records the stage and auditorium edges, box partition lines, rail, door leaves and stair treads as flat plan detail rather than extruded masonry.
